node.content-desc: Table with 5 rows and 4 columns. Additional columns are available

Row 1. Feature: **Eligibility**. **EPF**: Salaried employees in EPF-covered establishments; mandatory for many formal-sector workers.. **PPF**: Any resident individual can open an account.. **NPS**: Indian citizens aged 18–70; both salaried and self-employed can join.

node.text: Salaried employees in EPF-covered establishments; mandatory for many formal-sector workers.

node.content-desc: Row 2. Feature: **Contribution rules**. **EPF**: Employee contributes **12% of basic pay + dearness allowance**; employer also contributes.. **PPF**: **₹500 minimum** per year; **₹1.5 lakh maximum** per financial year.. **NPS**: **₹1,000 minimum** per year for Tier I; no upper limit on contribution.

node.text: Employee contributes 12% of basic pay + dearness allowance; employer also contributes.

node.content-desc: Row 3. Feature: **Lock-in / tenure**. **EPF**: Linked to employment; full withdrawal is generally at retirement or after qualifying exit.. **PPF**: **15 years** initial lock-in; extendable in 5-year blocks.. **NPS**: Locked until **age 60** for normal exit.

node.text: Linked to employment; full withdrawal is generally at retirement or after qualifying exit.

node.content-desc: Row 4. Feature: **Withdrawals**. **EPF**: Partial withdrawals allowed for specified needs; full withdrawal is tax-favoured after **5 years of continuous service**.. **PPF**: Partial withdrawal allowed from the **7th year**; premature closure only after **5 completed years** and for specified reasons.. **NPS**: Partial withdrawal allowed after **3 years**, generally up to **25% of own contributions** for specified purposes.

node.text: Partial withdrawals allowed for specified needs; full withdrawal is tax-favoured after 5 years of continuous service.

node.content-desc: Row 5. Feature: **Tax treatment**. **EPF**: Contributions may qualify for deduction under Section 80C; interest and eligible withdrawals are generally tax-free, but interest on employee contribution above **₹2.5 lakh/year** can be taxable.. **PPF**: Contributions qualify under Section 80C; interest and maturity are generally **fully tax-free**.. **NPS**: Employee contribution can get Section 80C benefit, plus an extra **₹50,000** under Section 80CCD(1B); at exit, a lump sum portion is tax-free, while annuity income is taxable.

node.text: Contributions may qualify for deduction under Section 80C; interest and eligible withdrawals are generally tax-free, but interest on employee contribution above ₹2.5 lakh/year can be taxable.
